title: BiEngineStatistics
description: Statistics for a BI Engine specific query. Populated as part of JobStatistics2

accelerationMode.description: Output only. Specifies which mode of BI Engine acceleration was performed (if any).

biEngineReasons.description: In case of DISABLED or PARTIAL bi_engine_mode, these contain the explanatory reasons as to why BI Engine could not accelerate. In case the full query was accelerated, this field is not populated.

biEngineMode.description: Output only. Specifies which mode of BI Engine acceleration was performed (if any).
